final: WITH scope_counts AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS scope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT scope, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, 1.0 * order_count / AVG(order_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM scope_counts ORDER BY scope
